That evening he lit the lamp early and left it burning until dawn, and for the first time in thirty-one years his log contained a single, unsteady word.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一台刚刚冷却的机器。高架桥上的路灯一盏接一盏地熄灭，清洁车拖着湿漉漉的水痕驶过空旷的街道。便利店的灯还亮着，店员靠在收银台后面打盹。远处传来第一班地铁的低鸣，像谁在黑暗里轻轻叹了一口气。写字楼里零星几扇窗亮着，那里有人还在赶一份明天要交的报告。天边慢慢渗出一线灰蓝，这座城市即将苏醒，而此刻，它只属于失眠的人。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself on a smaller version of the same problem.\n• It needs a base case, a stopping rule that says \"this small case is easy, just answer it,\" so it doesn't loop forever.\n• Think of Russian dolls: open one, find a smaller doll inside, and keep going until you reach the tiny solid one that doesn't open."}
